title: FineRR-ZNS: Enabling Fine-Granularity Read Refreshing for ZNS SSDs
problem: Zoned namespace SSDs lack read refreshing mechanisms to guarantee data reliability, and zone-level read refreshing incurs severe overhead due to large valid data movements, degrading I/O performance.
motivation: ZNS SSDs eliminate DRAM and garbage collection overhead but sacrifice read refreshing; fine-granularity refreshing is needed to maintain reliability without crippling I/O performance.
method: Proposes host-controlled fine-granularity read refreshing via metadata remapping at block level, includes zone reconstruction method to retrieve remapped data forming complete data, keeps remapped data available and prioritized for read access until next refresh cycle.
key_novelty: Block-level metadata remapping approach enabling fine-granularity read refreshing in ZNS SSDs with efficient zone reconstruction, eliminating zone-level refresh overhead.
contributions: Block-level metadata remapping scheme for fine-granularity read refreshing in ZNS SSDs
Zone reconstruction method to retrieve remapped data efficiently
Prioritized read-access scheme keeping remapped blocks available until next refresh
Significant performance improvement over zone-level read refreshing in ZenFS

metrics.other: Significantly enhanced read refreshing efficiency and I/O throughput vs. state-of-the-art ZenFS

limitations: Specific quantitative improvements vs. ZenFS not provided in abstract; long-term reliability validation data not discussed.
primary_theme: Fine-granularity read refreshing for ZNS SSDs via block-level metadata remapping
